# Portal HAR fixtures

Generated by `npm run refresh-fixtures`. Each JSON file captures one interactive portal browsing session's network traffic, sanitized per `scripts/refresh-fixtures.ts`.

**Scrubbed fields** (never commit otherwise):
- Headers matching: `Cookie`, `Set-Cookie`, `Authorization`, `X-CSRF-*`, anything with `session`/`token`/`csrf`/`X-Cfx-*`
- Body fields: `email`, `id`, `avatar_url`
- URL query params: `token`, `signature`, `X-Amz-Signature`
- Entire `grant_transfers` response field (dropped at boundary per D24)

Refresh when any portal API response shape changes. Commit the new JSON with a CHANGELOG entry.

## Running

```bash
# requires Google Chrome (stable) installed - the script drives it via Playwright
npm run refresh-fixtures
```

Log in to the portal in the launched browser, browse the endpoints of interest, then press Enter in the terminal. The script writes a timestamped JSON to this directory.
